title: Hide in Plain Sight
html:
See also: One with Shadows (class action)
Hide in Plain Sight is a Ranger class action. While remaining stationary, the ranger can use this action to become  Invisible and gain a +10 bonus to Stealth checks.

Description

Camouflage yourself with your environment to become Invisible and gain a +10 bonus on Stealth Checks, as long as you stand still.

Invisibility ends early if you move, attack, cast another spell, take an action, or take damage.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Details
 Range: Self
Duration: Until Long rest

Technical details

UID

Spell flags
IgnoreSilence, Invisible, Stealth

Condition: Hide in Plain Sight

 Hide in Plain Sight

Duration: Until Long rest

  • Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls. It has a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 10: Ranger

Notes

  • Actions like  Jump or  Fly do not break the invisibility so it is possible to move around while remaining invisible indefinitely. This applies to all other actions with the Invisible spell flag as well.
